comment: RustSec advisories accepted for a limited time. scripts/check-rust-advisories.py honours an entry only if it names the exact advisory, crate and version, has a non-empty approved_by (owner or security reviewer) and has not expired. An entry without approved_by is a proposal: the gate still fails.

exceptions.reason: Bundled SQLite 3.4x < 3.54.0 (CVE-2026-119375). No sqlx release accepts libsqlite3-sys >= 0.39: sqlx 0.8.6 needs ^0.30 and sqlx 0.9.0 needs < 0.38.
exceptions.mitigation: hc-audit-retention refuses to open state.db when its -wal page size differs from the database page size (the advisory's precondition; fsx::check_wal_page_size, test mismatched_wal_page_size_is_refused). Only the homelab-control user can write state.db and its WAL. Remove this entry when sqlx supports a patched libsqlite3-sys.
